steps.instruction: Heat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add 1 duck, cut into pieces, skin side down.
steps.spoken: Add the duck pieces to the pot skin side down, so the fat melts out.

steps.instruction: Flip the duck and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add 4 minced garlic cloves, 4 minced shallots and 2 sliced red chilies.
Stir-fry for a few minutes, until fragrant.
Pour in 2 cans of coconut milk.
Add 2 bruised lemongrass stalks, 4 kaffir lime leaves and 4 bay leaves.
Add 2 teaspoons of salt, 1 teaspoon of sugar and 1 teaspoon of tamarind paste.
Bring the pot to a boil.
Lower the heat and simmer for 1 hour, until the duck is tender.
steps.spoken: Lower the heat and simmer for about 1 hour, until the duck is tender and the sauce has thickened.
